messages.body: Hi, tracking says delivered but I can't find the parcel. Can you check?
Northline Courier shows it was signed for by J. Ellis on Oct 21. Could someone in your household have received it?
Any update on my tote bag order?
The jacket arrived but the colour looks much lighter than the photos.
Sorry to hear that. Our listing notes that denim is garment-washed so shades vary slightly between pieces.
Is this bag from your shop? I see a charge I don't recognise.
I'd like to return the overshirt, it doesn't fit.
No problem, send it back within 30 days and we'll refund you once it arrives.
I think I was charged twice for the blanket.
You're right, the second charge was a duplicate. We've refunded it (REF-5002).
